title: Voz pasiva (is made, was installed, will be tested)
goal: Al terminar podrás escribir reportes técnicos, procedimientos e informes de inspección en voz pasiva en cualquier tiempo (the joints were welded, the line has been tested, the tank will be filled), decidir cuándo usar pasiva y cuándo activa, y manejar las pasivas de la vida diaria (I was born, my flight was canceled, I was told…).

lesson.title: Introducción
lesson.html:
En la voz activa, el sujeto hace la acción: The welder repaired the joint. En la voz pasiva, el sujeto recibe la acción: The joint was repaired. El hecho es el mismo; cambia el foco. La pasiva pone adelante la cosa: la junta, el tanque, la válvula, el plano.

¿Por qué es tan importante en tu trabajo? Porque en un reporte técnico lo que importa es el equipo y el proceso, no la persona. Al cliente no le interesa si soldó Juan o Pedro; le interesa saber que la junta fue soldada, inspeccionada y aprobada. Por eso los procedimientos, los informes de inspección, las especificaciones y las normas (API, ASME, AWS) están llenos de pasivas. El español resuelve lo mismo con el se: se soldó, se inspeccionó, se aprobó.

lesson.title: La fórmula: BE + participio, en todos los tiempos
lesson.html:
Solo cambia el verbo be, que toma el tiempo que necesitas. El participio (3.ª columna) nunca cambia. Si sabes conjugar be, ya sabes conjugar toda la pasiva.

TiempoForma pasivaEjemploEn español
Presente simpleam / is / are + part.The tanks are fabricated in Houston.Los tanques se fabrican en Houston.
Presente continuoam / is / are + being + part.The weld is being inspected.Se está inspeccionando la soldadura.
Pasado simplewas / were + part.The valve was installed yesterday.La válvula se instaló ayer.
Pasado continuowas / were + being + part.The roof was being painted when it rained.Se estaba pintando el techo cuando llovió.
Presente perfectohas / have + been + part.The drawings have been approved.Los planos han sido aprobados.
Pasado perfectohad + been + part.The line had been drained before the cut.La línea había sido drenada antes del corte.
Futuro (will)will + be + part.The line will be tested on Friday.La línea será probada el viernes.
Futuro (going to)am / is / are + going to be + part.The pump is going to be replaced.Van a reemplazar la bomba.
Modalmodal + be + part.The area must be cleaned first.El área debe limpiarse primero.
Modal perfecto (Módulo 19)modal + have been + part.The test should have been done earlier.La prueba debió hacerse antes.

lesson.title: Reglas de oro
lesson.html:
Regla de oro 1 — BE lleva el tiempo; el participio no se toca

Toda la información de tiempo, persona y número está en be: is, are, was, were, has been, will be… El participio siempre es la 3.ª columna.

The pipes were delivered. Nunca The pipes were deliver. ni The pipes was delivered.

Regla de oro 2 — BY + agente solo si aporta información

En el 80 % de las pasivas no se dice quién lo hizo, porque es obvio, desconocido o no importa. Usa by cuando el agente es la noticia o es un dato que el lector necesita.

The tank was built in 1998. (no importa quién) · The welds were inspected by a certified third-party inspector. (el dato importa)

Regla de oro 3 — Sin objeto no hay pasiva

Solo los verbos con objeto (transitivos) tienen pasiva. Happen, occur, arrive, die, appear no tienen objeto, así que no existen en pasiva; fail y leak tampoco, cuando significan "fallar" y "fugar".

The accident happened at 3 p.m. Nunca The accident was happened. The flange leaked. Nunca The flange was leaked.

lesson.title: ¿Pasiva o activa? Cómo decide un nativo
lesson.html:
Así piensa un nativo — pasiva para el reporte, activa para el compromiso

En un informe técnico el nativo escribe The bottom plates were replaced and all welds were vacuum-box tested. Es objetivo e impersonal. Pero en un correo al cliente prefiere la activa, porque suena directa y responsable: We will replace the gasket tomorrow.

Ojo con la pasiva "para esconderse": Mistakes were made. (se cometieron errores) evita decir quién falló. Un buen jefe lo nota. Cuando el error es tuyo, usa la activa: I made a mistake in the drawing.

lesson.title: SHALL en normas y especificaciones
lesson.html: En API 650, ASME B31.3 o AWS D1.1 verás The tank shall be hydrostatically tested. En normas, shall = obligatorio (requisito); should = recomendado; may = permitido. En conversación casi no se usa shall. Lo verás a fondo en el Módulo 33.

lesson.title: Traducción directa vs interpretación real
lesson.html:
El español casi nunca usa ser + participio (fue instalado) al hablar; prefiere el se o la tercera persona plural (me robaron). El inglés no tiene se impersonal: usa la pasiva.

Lo que piensas en españolLo que dice un nativo
Se habla inglés.English is spoken here.
Me robaron la billetera.My wallet was stolen.
Le dieron un bono.He was given a bonus.
Me dijeron que esperara.I was told to wait.
Nací en Talara.I was born in Talara.
Se dice que va a llover.It's supposed to rain.
EspañolTraducción literal (mal)Inglés real
Se fabrican tanques.Are fabricated tanks.Tanks are fabricated here.
Se necesitan dos soldadores.Need two welders.Two welders are needed.
Me robaron el celular.They robbed my phone.My phone was stolen.
Me dijeron que esperara.I was said to wait.I was told to wait.
Nací en 1995.I born in 1995.I was born in 1995.
No se encontraron defectos.Not found defects.No defects were found.

lesson.title: Afirmativo, negativo, pregunta y respuesta corta
lesson.html:
La pasiva funciona como el verbo be o como el primer auxiliar: se niega con not y se pregunta invirtiendo el primer auxiliar. Nunca necesita do/does/did.

EstructuraEjemplo
AfirmativoSujeto + be + participioThe joint was repaired.
NegativoSujeto + be + not + participioThe joint wasn't repaired.
Pregunta(WH-) + be + sujeto + participio?Was the joint repaired? · When was it repaired?
Respuesta cortaYes, sujeto + be. / No, sujeto + be + not.Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
Con auxiliarPrimer auxiliar adelanteHas the line been tested? — Yes, it has. · Will it be painted? — No, it won't.

lesson.title: Detalles que marcan la diferencia
lesson.html:
• Dos objetos: They gave Ana a bonus. → lo natural es empezar por la persona: Ana was given a bonus. Igual con told, sent, shown, offered, asked.
  • Pasiva con GET (informal, cosas que "le pasan" a alguien): He got fired. · I got paid yesterday. · The truck got stuck. No la uses en reportes.
  • Pasiva impersonal (formal): It was agreed that… · It was found that… · It is expected that… Muy útil en actas y conclusiones.
  • Have something done = mandar a hacer: I had my car repaired. (no lo reparé yo; lo mandé a reparar).

dialog.text: Hi Edwin, it's Sarah from the terminal. How's the Tank 12 repair going?
Good morning, Sarah. It's going well. All the corroded plates have been removed, and twelve new plates were installed yesterday.
Great. Have the welds been inspected yet?
The first ten joints have. The rest are being vacuum-box tested right now.
Yes, a small pore was found on joint B-7. It was ground out and rewelded this morning.
OK. When will the hydrotest be done?
If everything goes well, the tank will be filled on Friday. The water must be approved by your lab first.
I'll take care of that. Will the test be witnessed by a third-party inspector?
Yes, an inspector has been booked for Friday at 8. The full report will be sent to you on Monday.

examples.es: ¿La propina está incluida en la cuenta?

examples.en: Your card has been blocked for security reasons.
examples.es: Su tarjeta ha sido bloqueada por razones de seguridad.

examples.en: You will be given the results tomorrow.
The contract was signed last week, and the first payment is expected in May.
examples.es: El contrato se firmó la semana pasada y se espera el primer pago en mayo.

examples.en: This tank was built in 1998 and had never been repaired before.
examples.es: Este tanque se construyó en 1998 y nunca había sido reparado antes.

examples.es: Los empaques debieron verificarse contra la hoja de datos.

errors.why: La pasiva necesita el participio, no la forma base.

errors.wrong: The accident was happened at night.
errors.why: Happen no tiene objeto; no existe en pasiva.
Be concuerda con el sujeto: valves es plural → were.
El inglés exige sujeto; el se español no existe.

errors.wrong: The line will tested on Friday.
errors.right: The line will be tested on Friday.
errors.why: Futuro pasivo = will be + participio. Sin be no hay pasiva.
Después de being también va participio.

errors.wrong: The report was written for Ana. (= por Ana)
errors.right: The report was written by Ana.
errors.why: El agente se introduce con by. For = para.

errors.wrong: I borned in 1995. / I was borned.
errors.why: "Nacer" es siempre pasiva: was born. Borned no existe.
Say no lleva persona como objeto; con persona se usa tell → I was told.

falseFriends.means: se hizo realidad / se dio cuenta (no se usa así)
falseFriends.fix: The test was carried out / performed.

falseFriends.means: se agruparon (palabra rara, casi no se usa)

A1.prompt: Los tanques se fabrican en Houston.
answers: Tanks are fabricated in Houston.
The tanks are fabricated in Houston.
Tanks are manufactured in Houston.
The tanks are manufactured in Houston.
Tanks are made in Houston.
The tanks are made in Houston.
A1.explain: Presente simple pasivo: are (plural) + participio. También: The tanks are manufactured…

answers: The valve was installed yesterday.

A1.prompt: La línea será probada mañana a las 8.
answers: The line will be tested tomorrow at 8.
The line will be tested at 8 tomorrow.
The line will be tested tomorrow at 8 a.m.
The line will be tested tomorrow at eight.

A1.prompt: En este momento se están inspeccionando las soldaduras.
answers: The welds are being inspected right now.
The welds are being inspected at the moment.
Right now, the welds are being inspected.
At the moment, the welds are being inspected.
A1.explain: Presente continuo pasivo: are being + participio. "En este momento" = right now / at the moment.

A1.prompt: Los planos ya han sido aprobados.
answers: The drawings have already been approved.
A1.explain: Presente perfecto pasivo: have been; already va entre have y been.

A1.prompt: El área debe limpiarse antes de pintar.
answers: The area must be cleaned before painting.
The area has to be cleaned before painting.
A1.explain: Modal pasivo: must be + participio. Tras before, gerundio (painting).

A1.prompt: Me robaron la billetera en el aeropuerto.
answers: My wallet was stolen at the airport.
A1.explain: "Me robaron" = pasiva con la cosa como sujeto. Steal → stole → stolen; no robbed (rob es a la persona o al lugar).

answers: When was this tank built?
A1.explain: WH- + was + sujeto + participio. Build → built.

answers: No defects were found.
A1.explain: No + sustantivo plural + were + found. No se usa not.

answers: The test should have been done earlier.
The test should have been carried out earlier.
The test should have been done before.
A1.explain: Modal perfecto pasivo (Módulo 19 + 20): should have been + participio. También: carried out earlier.

A2.prompt: Three joints were rejected and will be repaired on Monday.
answers: Se rechazaron tres juntas y se repararán el lunes.
Tres juntas fueron rechazadas y serán reparadas el lunes.
Tres juntas fueron rechazadas y se repararán el lunes.
A2.explain: Pasado pasivo (were rejected) + futuro pasivo (will be repaired).

A2.prompt: Breakfast is included in the price.
answers: El desayuno está incluido en el precio.
El precio incluye el desayuno.
El desayuno viene incluido en el precio.
A2.explain: Is included = está incluido; el español usa estar porque describe un estado.

A2.prompt: The pump is being replaced, so the line is out of service.
answers: Se está reemplazando la bomba, así que la línea está fuera de servicio.
La bomba está siendo reemplazada, así que la línea está fuera de servicio.
Se está cambiando la bomba, por eso la línea está fuera de servicio.
A2.explain: Presente continuo pasivo = se está + gerundio.

A2.prompt: I was told to wait outside.
answers: Me dijeron que esperara afuera.
Me dijeron que esperase fuera.
Me pidieron que esperara afuera.
A2.explain: I was told to… = me dijeron que… El español usa "ellos" implícito.

A2.prompt: The flanges had been tightened before the test started.
answers: Las bridas habían sido ajustadas antes de que empezara la prueba.
Las bridas se habían ajustado antes de que empezara la prueba.
Las bridas habían sido apretadas antes de que comenzara la prueba.
A2.explain: Pasado perfecto pasivo: had been tightened. También: se habían ajustado.

B.prompt: The report was write by Ana.
answers: The report was written by Ana.

B.prompt: The leak was happened during the night shift.
answers: The leak happened during the night shift.
B.explain: Happen no tiene pasiva; se quita was.

B.prompt: The new pipes was delivered this morning.
answers: The new pipes were delivered this morning.

B.prompt: The tank will inspected next week.
answers: The tank will be inspected next week.

B.prompt: The weld is being repair right now.
answers: The weld is being repaired right now.

B.prompt: The drawings were approved from the client yesterday.
answers: The drawings were approved by the client yesterday.
B.explain: El agente va con by, no con from.

B.prompt: Is spoken English in this hotel.
answers: English is spoken in this hotel.
B.explain: Faltaba el sujeto adelante: English + is + spoken.

answers: I was born in Talara.
B.explain: El participio es born; borned no existe.

answers: The meeting has been canceled.
The meeting has been cancelled.
B.explain: Después de been, participio: canceled (EE. UU.; cancelled en Reino Unido).

B.prompt: I was said to wear a helmet.
answers: I was told to wear a helmet.
B.explain: Con la persona como sujeto se usa tell: I was told.

bonus.prompt: Pasa a pasiva sin agente: The inspector rejected two welds. Luego conviértela en pregunta.
bonus.answer: Two welds were rejected. → Were two welds rejected? (Con WH-: How many welds were rejected?)

C1.instructions: Completa el diálogo con estas palabras; usa cada una una sola vez: was, were, been, being, be, by, is, will.

lines.text: Hi Edwin. What's the status of Tank 5?
The new bottom plates [1] installed last week, and all the welds have [2] inspected.
Yes, one small crack [3] found [4] the NDT technician.
Not yet. It's [5] repaired right now.
The tank [6] be filled on Friday. The water must [7] approved by your lab first.
When can I see the final report?
The final report [8] always written after the test, so you'll have it on Monday.

answers: were
blanks.explain: Pasado simple pasivo con sujeto plural (plates) + last week.

answers: been
blanks.explain: Presente perfecto pasivo: have been inspected.

answers: was
blanks.explain: Pasado simple pasivo con sujeto singular (one small crack).

answers: by
blanks.explain: Agente con by; aquí el dato (quién lo encontró) importa.

answers: being
blanks.explain: Presente continuo pasivo: it's being repaired.

answers: will
be
is
blanks.explain: Presente simple pasivo para un procedimiento habitual (always).

C2.prompt: Redacta un reporte diario de obra (7 puntos). Escribe 6 a 8 oraciones sobre un trabajo real o inventado (reparación de tanque, montaje de tubería, soportes). Debe incluir: (a) dos acciones terminadas en pasado simple pasivo; (b) una en presente perfecto pasivo; (c) una en presente continuo pasivo; (d) una en futuro pasivo; (e) una con modal pasivo (must / should / can be); (f) un agente con by que aporte información; (g) encabezado con fecha y una línea de cierre profesional.
rubric: (a) dos acciones terminadas en pasado simple pasivo
(e) una con modal pasivo (must / should / can be)
(f) un agente con by que aporte información
(g) encabezado con fecha y una línea de cierre profesional
C2.model:
Daily Report – Tank T-12 Bottom Repair – October 14
Today, the last four bottom plates were installed, and all lap joints were welded. Twenty joints have been vacuum-box tested so far, and no leaks have been found. The remaining joints are being tested this afternoon. The tank will be filled with water on Friday for the hydrotest. Before filling, the manhole gaskets must be replaced. The test will be witnessed by a third-party API 653 inspector. Please contact me if you have any questions.
Edwin Prieto – Piping and Mechanical Design Engineer
